antiDefaults: Bubbly chat bubbles with avatars and rounded message cards: likely because commodity chatbots set the pattern and bubbles suggest friendliness; remains right only for social or companion chat where speaker identity is the content; alternative mechanism here is the affidavit register — small-caps rail labels YOU / AGENT / TOOL on a continuous ground, so role is certified by label and order, not by bubble shape.

Card piles with shadows and elevated panels for every turn and tool: likely because card systems are the fastest way to show grouping; remains right only for heterogeneous dashboards where each card is an independent object; alternative mechanism here is the ruled ledger — hairline rules separate turns and docked tool rows, and only world-changing controls (send, interrupt, retry) earn elevation, so depth means evidentiary depth.

Ambient AI gradient (purple/blue glow) as identity: likely because it signals modernity at a glance; remains right only for marketing or empty-state delight where no functional identity exists yet; alternative mechanism here is rationed signal color — desaturated paper and steel grounds with saturated color appearing only on status and diff tokens paired with label plus icon, so color always certifies something.

Streaming theater plus auto-dismissing toasts for progress and errors: likely because streaming text feels alive and toasts keep the layout clean; remains right only for transient confirmations with no accountability cost; alternative mechanism here is attestation in place — skeleton rows resolve into final ruled rows where the work happened, and failures render in place with retry, so nothing consequential ever auto-dismisses.

Literal dark terminal-green console theme for the whole surface: likely because phosphor-terminal heritage reads technical fast; remains right only for a full-time operator console viewed in the dark; alternative mechanism here is the paper ledger with a restrained status-pip plus label system that works on light grounds and survives grayscale, keeping the reading column calm under a dense workbench.

Single lonely chat column with verification hidden behind tabs or external pages: likely because it is the simplest layout to build and the easiest to make responsive; remains right only for one-shot Q&A with nothing to verify; alternative mechanism here is the dossier with session-scoped wings — low-density center plus high-density wings, with the right wing as an evidence bench that cites back Session N / Turn M, so evidence never detaches from its claim.
color: Quiet grounds carry reading; saturated color only certifies, because the thesis says prose reads and evidence certifies. Ground means calm paper continuity (warm-neutral matte) for the conversation; chrome means desaturated steel for rails and sidebars, visually subordinate to the center. Signal means the status triad — success green, running amber, failed red — rationed to pips, durations, and diff tokens, always paired with a text label plus icon so meaning survives grayscale and meets AA contrast (C-A2). Reference blue means linkage (URLs, file paths as links, GitHub refs), never decoration. Diff green/red mean added/removed only, confined to evidence rows and annex pages. Rationing rule: no saturated fill larger than a pip, badge, or diff token appears without an adjacent label; ambient gradients and glow are excluded because a recorder never decorates the record.
composition: Dossier: a calm central reading column (Tier 1 conversation plus composer) flanked by ruled audit wings, because the thesis demands that prose reads while evidence certifies. Hierarchy: Tier 1 is the current answer with its docked tool rows; Tier 2 is session resumption (left wing ledger of projects grouping sessions) plus tool summaries; Tier 3 is tool detail and the right-wing evidence bench (browser excerpt, file tree plus diff, GitHub ref summary), each annex page carrying its own header. Tool rows dock directly beneath the assistant turn that claims them — never in a detached timeline — so the page accretes top-to-bottom as a record, not as chat. Density is split on purpose: low in the center (generous measure around 60-70ch, airy leading, one claim per viewport) and high in the wings (dense tabular rows with kind, target, status, duration shown without apology). Responsive: at 1440px all three panes dock; at mid widths one wing overlays while the reading column keeps its measure; at 375px a single column with both wings as drawers and the composer persistently reachable, with no horizontal page scroll — the desk is never crushed by its wings.
divergenceAxes: Compositional model: dossier record (reading column plus ruled audit rail with docked rows) versus the category-default single chat column and versus ops-board status grids, editorial marginalia, and spine-plus-ticket time rails.

Information density distribution: deliberately split low-center/high-wings versus uniform-density chat, high-everywhere control rooms, lowest-everywhere reading rooms, and rhythmic ticket compression.

Motion role: attestation (only certifying state flips and skeleton-to-row resolution move) versus decorative streaming shimmer, signal-pulsing alerts, breath-like fades, and progress-along-a-rail narration.

Surface logic: paper ledger separated by hairline rules with elevation reserved for world-changing controls versus card piles with shadows, dark instrument wells, floating glass sheets, and ticket-stack cards.

Typographic voice: affidavit tri-voice (reading grotesk/serif prose plus small-caps rail labels plus evidence-only tabular mono) versus mono-forward console, editorial serif-only, and workmanlike grotesk with turn numerals.
domainWorld: Wells and rules, not card piles: the bench separates live regions as inset wells and completed work as ruled rows, with shadows shallow and rare — crossed into a paper-ledger surface where rules do the grouping and only send, interrupt, and retry earn elevation.

Flight-recorder and lab-notebook accountability: every consequential step leaves a timestamped, retrievable entry initialed by its evidence — crossed one level further from depiction into mechanism as docked tool rows plus the cite-back rule, so no assistant claim stands on prose alone.

Burst-pause-verify rhythm: slow deliberate typing, fast mixed-duration tool bursts (millisecond Reads, seconds-long Bash/tests), then verification, steering, or interruption — crossed into motion as attestation, where skeletons resolve into rows and status flips certify completion with no ambient animation.

Bench, library, and mission-wall spatial order: the user directs from a central reading desk, glances left to resume and right to verify — crossed into session-scoped wings where the left wing resumes (projects group sessions) and the right wing proves (evidence scoped to the active Session.id).

Trust-but-verify anxiety under vigilance fatigue: delegating consequential work to a fast junior while staying accountable is exhausting to watch — crossed into split density (calm low-density center under a dense but disciplined workbench) plus in-place failure with retry, so vigilance costs less.
evidencePlan: Specimen 1 — first view at 1440px: populated session with real-length prose, two assistant turns each with docked Write/Read/Bash rows, both sidebars docked, hierarchy resolved.
Specimen 2 — signature in use: right-wing evidence bench showing the cite-back header (Session N / Turn M plus tool target) for files, browser, and GitHub views.
Specimen 3 — central component: tool-row group in collapsed (summary plus status pip plus duration) and expanded (detail, command, excerpt, cite-back footer) states.
Specimen 4 — non-happy states: running skeleton resolving to rows, failed tool with in-place retry, empty session ledger, and empty sidebar-view annex.
Specimen 5 — typography and surface at working density: affidavit register (prose, small-caps YOU/AGENT/TOOL labels, tabular mono evidence) on ruled paper with no shadows.
Specimen 6 — responsive behavior at 375px: single reading column with wings as drawers and persistently reachable composer.
motion: Motion is attestation: nothing moves except transitions that certify work, because a recorder never performs. Running flips to succeeded or failed with a single pip-plus-label swap; skeleton rows resolve into final ruled rows staged from stub durations (fast Reads settle first, longer Bash/tests follow); disclosure expands and collapses in place with one short height ease; session and view switches cut rather than slide. Streaming prose shows only a quiet caret — no shimmer, no typewriter bounce. Interrupt and retry acknowledge instantly (optimistic echo under ~300ms). Under reduced motion every change is an instant swap that remains legible statically, since status is always carried by label plus icon, never by animation alone.
productInterpretation: This product is an accountability record for delegated coding work, not a chatbot: a session-scoped dossier where each instruction, each tool act, and each piece of evidence is entered, ordered, and citable, so a builder can direct fast, verify without leaving the surface, and resume tomorrow knowing exactly what happened.
risks: Reads archival or slow: ruled paper plus restrained motion can feel bureaucratic rather than capable unless prose rhythm and status crispness carry energy.
Failures lose urgency on a quiet ground: amber/red must be unmissable in place without resorting to glow or toast theater.
Dense wings overwhelm the calm center: tabular evidence can leak visual noise into the reading path if rule weights and rail caps slip.
Ledger monotony across 50-plus turns: undifferentiated ruled rows blur together unless turn order, status, and cite-back references stay scannable.
Mono overuse: tabular mono confined to evidence is load-bearing; any drift into prose or chrome collapses the affidavit voice.
Streaming under-stimulation: resisting shimmer is principled but risks feeling frozen during long stub runs unless skeleton-to-row staging is clearly progressive.
signature: The cite-back rule: every verification view and every expanded tool detail carries its turn-and-tool reference (Session N / Turn M plus tool kind and target, e.g. Session 12 / Turn 4 — Edit src/auth.ts), so evidence never detaches from the claim that produced it. It recurs in four places: the right-wing annex header, the expanded tool-row footer, error and empty annex headers, and the mobile sheet header when wings become drawers. Frequency is regulated by slot discipline: exactly one cite-back line per evidence container, set in 12px tabular mono directly beneath the view title in a fixed slot; it never appears inside prose, never repeats per inner row, and is omitted only for session-level emptiness where it reads Session N — no turns yet. Recurrence therefore reads as a certification system, not a tic.
surfaces: Paper ledger: one continuous matte reading ground for the conversation, because the thesis needs calm. Separation comes from hairline rules between turns and between docked tool rows — never from shadows or card fills. Live regions (streaming prose, running tools) read as shallow inset wells; completed work reads as ruled rows; verification views read as stamped annex pages with their own header rule and cite-back line, giving evidentiary depth without elevation. The only raised elements are the composer and the world-changing controls (send, interrupt, retry), each with a single restrained cap. Empty, loading, and error states replace content in place within the same ruled slot — never as overlays or toasts — so the record never breaks its own ruling.
systemPotential: The ledger is a component language, not a hero: ruled rows, status pips with labels, tabular evidence slots, annex headers with cite-back lines, and the raised composer cap compose every surface. Other surfaces reuse them directly — session history as a ruled resumption ledger with per-session status, file diffs as annex pages with diff-token color plus mono, browser excerpts as annex pages with reference-blue links, GitHub refs as annex tables with commit mono. Long content (50-plus turns) compresses by collapsing settled tool rows to summary lines while turn numerals and cite-back references stay visible, plus a jump index keyed to turn order and failures. Short content (empty session, empty wing view) renders as a ruled placeholder row inside the same slot with an explicit state label and next action. Every state ships in the language: loading as skeleton rows resolving in place, error as an in-place ruled row with retry, overflow as truncated mono with in-place expand. Viewports scale by rule, not redesign: 1440px three docked panes, mid widths one docked plus one overlaid wing, 375px single column with wings as drawers and the composer persistently reachable, cite-back slot intact at every width.
thesis: Every agent claim is entered into a calm, ruled dossier where prose reads and evidence certifies.
typography: Affidavit register, because the thesis needs reading to feel sworn and evidence to feel quoted. Three voices with strict jurisdictions: a highly legible reading face (quiet grotesk or transitional serif) for user and assistant prose at true text size with generous leading carries the reading; small-caps rail labels (YOU / AGENT / TOOL) at 11px with tracking carry role and order in the audit rail; tabular mono carries evidence only — paths, commands, durations, refs, hashes — at 12-13px with aligned numerals. Scale logic is restraint: hierarchy comes from voice contrast and rule position, not from large display sizes; the loudest element on the page is a status label, never a headline. Chrome (session titles, tab labels, follow-ups, modes) uses a small structured sans subordinate to prose. Mono appearing outside evidence is a defect, which is exactly what keeps the affidavit legible at wing density.
